text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired -> service=embeddings-api-eu severity=page. Symptom: sudden 5xx spike (~12% error rate over last 2 min). PD escalation window 2m. Links: https://ops.redwood/alerts/1766543210

emma: acked — I'm taking initial triage, joining bridge now :eyes:

tariq: oncall infra here, will help with pool/route changes if needed. ETA ~5m.

samir: quick heads-up — we can route EU embed traffic to dedicated-pool-2 as a hotfix, we have capacity. Will coordinate.

chen: need customer-impact summary asap, cc @cust-liaison. Also note any PD auto-escalations.

cust-liaison: seeing inbound errors from 3 customers (two fintech, one marketplace). Opening support tickets and sending initial notice. Marking impacted=true.

emma: quick triage: embedding workers returning 502s, host gpu-node-12 showing repeated OOM/restarts and high KV cache eviction rates. Suspect cache storm/eviction cascade. Pulling logs now:
```
$ kubectl -n infra logs embed-worker-12 | tail -n 50
[2026-03-17T21:07:42Z] ERROR inference: kv cache eviction threshold reached
[2026-03-17T21:07:43Z] WARN memory: OOM killed process: worker
[2026-03-17T21:07:44Z] ERROR http: 502 upstream read error
```

samir: mitigation plan: 1) route traffic off trouble pool to dedicated-pool-2; 2) scale dedicated-pool-2 to 4 replicas; 3) keep prefix cache disabled for that pool for 10m. Commands I recommend:
`redwood ctl route set --service embeddings-api-eu --to dedicated-pool-2 --weight 100`
`redwood infra scale pool dedicated-pool-2 --replicas 4`

emma: running route change and scale now. Pasting output:
```
$ redwood ctl route set --service embeddings-api-eu --to dedicated-pool-2 --weight 100
INFO routing: updated embeddings-api-eu -> dedicated-pool-2 (100%)
$ redwood infra scale pool dedicated-pool-2 --replicas 4
INFO infra: scaling dedicated-pool-2 from 2 -> 4 replicas (requested by emma)
```

pagerbot: PagerDuty note: automatic escalation timer canceled (page ack by emma). No further escalation will occur while acknowledged.

tariq: seeing new pool come up, health checks passing on replicas. I'll watch for KV cache re-population effects.

chen: please confirm customer-facing message. We'll prepare a short status update: root cause suspected KV cache eviction on embed workers leading to 502s; mitigation = emergency traffic reroute to dedicated pool + scale; monitoring shows error rates dropping.

cust-liaison: posted update to affected customers: "We're investigating an intermittent 5xx for embeddings in EU. Traffic has been rerouted to a healthy pool; we'll follow up with a timeline and RCA." Customers acknowledged the note.

emma: metrics: error rate down from ~12% to ~0.8% in last 3m after reroute. Latency slightly higher (~120ms -> 170ms) but acceptable. Leaving monitoring on for 15m. Planning handoff to infra for follow-up & RCA.

tariq: taking handoff at 1766543380. I'll own follow-up: check KV cache eviction thresholds, node health, and whether nightly job triggered this. Will post RCA draft in #postmortems.

chen: thanks. Create postmortem placeholder and link the incident ID. Also add runbook note about temporarily disabling prefix cache if eviction cascade detected.

emma: closing our active mitigation loop from a triage perspective — we'll remain available if things regress. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Page marked resolved by emma at 1766543490. Final status: mitigated, handoff to infra (tariq) for follow-up.
